en.card.guide: Containers, images, Compose projects, networks and volumes on this machine and SSH hosts
en.card.name: Docker containers
en.card.summary: Containers and images on this machine / SSH hosts; read-only by default, changes must be enabled explicitly
en.check.allowExec: Allow one-shot exec (panel command box and docker_exec; interactive container access is not gated by it)
en.check.allowMutations: Allow changes (start/stop/remove containers, pull / remove / prune images)
en.confirm.endTerminalHint: If you only need room for the logs or the list, hit the collapse button at the top right of the drawer instead — the session keeps running.
en.confirm.endTerminalText: Closing the panel ends the terminal session for “{label}” (docker exec -it …).
en.confirm.pruneImages: Prune every untagged (<none>:<none>) image layer on this target to free disk space; tagged images are untouched.
en.confirm.pruneNetworks: Prune every network with no containers attached on this target. Compose project networks are included (they are recreated on the next up), but a running project briefly loses its network.
en.confirm.pruneVolumes: Prune every volume not used by a container on this target — the data inside is deleted with it and cannot be recovered. docker ≥ 23 removes only anonymous volumes (no --all), older versions also remove named ones; check that no data volume must be kept.
en.confirm.removeContainer: Remove container {name}? Its writable layer and configuration are deleted (named volumes are kept). This cannot be undone.
en.confirm.removeImage: Remove image {ref}? It fails while containers or child images reference it; afterwards you must pull or rebuild to restore it, and this cannot be undone.
en.confirm.removeNetwork: Remove network {name}? Docker refuses while containers are still attached; afterwards its containers lose the network and must be recreated or attached elsewhere.
en.confirm.removeVolume: Remove volume {name}? Its data is deleted with it and cannot be recovered; docker refuses while containers still use it.
en.elev.copyAllHint: Each capability needs its own command. Paste both lines at once; every switch unlocks by itself once they run (each on its own probe cycle).
en.elev.copyManual: The clipboard is unavailable here — select the command above and copy it manually.
en.elev.disableFirst: Turn this config switch off first
en.elev.envHow: In the environment that launched dsh: export {env}=1, then restart the host. Setting it after launch — or writing it into some other config file — does not count as a grant; that is exactly what this gate guards against.
en.elev.expired: This confirmation has expired — generate a new one.
en.elev.lockedWhy: Any local process can send loopback requests, so “turn on a dangerous capability” cannot be decided by this page alone — it has to be confirmed on the host’s filesystem once.
en.elev.otherWay: The other way (strongest, needs a host restart)
en.elev.revoked: Host grant revoked (the config switch is left untouched; granting again takes effect immediately).
en.elev.step: Run the command below in a terminal on the host and the switch unlocks by itself:
en.elev.title: Grant in place (no restart)
en.elev.viaEnv: Granted by a launch environment variable; to revoke, remove it from the launch environment and restart the host.
en.elev.waiting: Waiting for confirmation… once you run the command this turns into “granted” automatically.

en.error.noConversationService: The host has no conversation service

en.field.name: Name
en.hint.addSshInline: (fill in host/username, or pick a bookmark)
en.hint.addSshTarget: — add a kind=ssh target under Settings → Docker containers
en.hint.addTarget: For an SSH target, prefer picking a tty terminal panel bookmark (credentials live in one place); when filling in manually, write the password / passphrase as env:NAME (credential reference: resolved by the official credential store, falling back to the environment variable).
en.hint.addTargetEmpty: Add a target under Settings → Docker containers: pick “Local” for this machine; for a remote host you can reference a tty terminal panel bookmark.
en.hint.aggBufferExceeded: Aggregated logs exceeded the buffer limit ({lines} rows / {mb}MB); the oldest content was dropped
en.hint.aggRun: Aggregate the selected containers' logs into one stream
en.hint.aggTail: Initial rows fetched per container ({containers} containers → about {rows} rows); changing it reconnects every stream
en.hint.attentionDegraded: {count} target(s) returned degraded results (some container details were unavailable — OOM / restart loops may be missed)
en.hint.attentionTruncated: Attention results truncated: {targets} target(s) returned {total} rows in total; only the first {shown} are listed
en.hint.autoOff: Pause polling while FOLLOW is on
en.hint.autoOn: Re-fetch log snapshots at the interval below
en.hint.autoRefreshTitle: Auto refresh interval (used while AUTO REFRESH is on)
en.hint.bufferExceeded: Logs exceeded the buffer limit ({lines} rows / {mb}MB); the oldest content was dropped
en.hint.byteCap: This is a “byte” cap, not a row cap — so LINES = 5000 may still return only part of it. To keep more logs, raise “Output limit (KB)” in the settings card, or turn on FOLLOW (the stream is not bound by it).
en.hint.capabilityNotGranted: ⚠ Not granted by the host: these two switches cannot be turned on right now — clicking one gives you a command to confirm in place (no restart). Turning them off always works.
en.hint.connectLocal: Add a local target pointing at the machine running the host and select it (reuses an existing local target); SSH and custom targets stay untouched.
en.hint.conversationHidden: · the session is behind this panel: close or minimise the panel/terminal to see it
en.hint.diagHistoryDeduped: Same as the last run — not recorded again within 30 seconds
en.hint.diagHistoryStored: History keeps verdicts and numbers only — never raw logs
en.hint.diagReadOnly: Read-only: state, logs, events and resource usage in one pass
en.hint.diskDegraded: This docker version does not expose per-object disk usage; only the summary is shown
en.hint.dockerBin: docker by default; for podman put podman
en.hint.eventsClosedNoAuto: Will not recover on its own — click Reconnect
en.hint.eventsToggle: Container event activity (docker events): click to collapse / expand
en.hint.execDisabled: Enable “Allow exec” under Settings → Docker containers, or copy the exec command from the card into the terminal panel to enter the container interactively.
en.hint.exportLog: Plain text, lines exactly as they are
en.hint.exportMd: With source and row-count header, good as a ticket attachment
en.hint.exportMenu: Export what is displayed: .log (plain text) / .md (with source and row-count header, good as a ticket attachment)
en.hint.fetchFailed: (the request never reached the host: it may have just restarted, or the connection was interrupted)
en.hint.fillDraft: Not sent; the terminal is collapsed, edit it in the session and send
en.hint.followOff: Stop live follow (back to log snapshots)
en.hint.inlineCreds: The inline target uses key/password auth; the browser cannot obtain the credentials
en.hint.keyPath: Supports ~ and ~/ expansion (not ~user); use absolute paths on Windows
en.hint.levelFilter: Filter by log level (shows ≥ the selected level; lines without a level prefix continue the previous line and follow its level)
en.hint.localTarget: docker on the machine running the host
en.hint.logBacklog: Host-side log backlog exceeded the limit (the push rate outran the browser); disconnected and reconnecting. A reconnect only appends new lines, history is not replayed
en.hint.logSkipped: Host-side backlog: {frames} batches of earlier logs were skipped (content is not contiguous); following continues, no reconnect needed
en.hint.logSkippedNoCount: Host-side backlog: a batch of earlier logs was skipped (content is not contiguous); following continues, no reconnect needed
en.hint.logTailDefault: Initial value of LINES on the panel's log page (adjustable there); it is only a “row” cap — the snapshot also has to pass the byte gate below, so this many rows is not guaranteed
en.hint.logTailTitle: Rows fetched from the tail. The snapshot is also capped by the “Output limit (KB)” setting (currently {kb}KB) — enough rows can still truncate on bytes, so fewer rows may come back; the FOLLOW stream is not bound by that byte cap (this panel's buffer limit applies instead).
en.hint.maxOutput: “Byte” cap for a single output: shared by log snapshots / inspect / exec; enough rows can still truncate on bytes (the panel shows a truncation banner). The FOLLOW stream is not bound by it
en.hint.memSpark: Memory usage % over the last 60 samples
en.hint.noHistory: This docker version has neither history --format (needs Docker ≥ 26) nor a plain-text table that could be parsed.
en.hint.openPanelCurrentHost: Open the Docker container panel for the current session host
en.hint.openPanelForTarget: Open the Docker container panel for this host (target: {target})
en.hint.openPanelUnconfigured: This host is not configured as a Docker target yet — click to open the panel and view/configure
en.hint.openTerminal: Open an interactive terminal in the container (docker exec -it {name} sh)
en.hint.orderTimeHint: Merge by container timestamp (one true timeline across containers, costs about {ms}ms of delay)
en.hint.outputTruncated: Log output exceeded the “Output limit ({kb}KB)” and was truncated
en.hint.overviewNoTargets: Add targets under Settings → Docker containers and the overview summarizes every host on one screen.
en.hint.pause: Pause (freeze the current picture: new logs keep arriving but are not appended, so the view is not pushed away)
en.hint.pickBudget: Aggregated logs use a single SSE connection shared by every selected container; the Activity strip's event stream is separate
en.hint.pickMany: Close to the limit — more will be hard to read
en.hint.pickMaxLocal: At most {max} containers — beyond that the merged view gets hard to read, and each one adds another logs process on the host
en.hint.pickMaxSsh: At most {max} containers — beyond that the merged view gets hard to read, and the SSH channels fill up
en.hint.pickPreset: Tick containers matching “{label}” in the current filter (at most {max} streams)
en.hint.pickPresetOver: ; {count} more exceed the limit and will not be selected
en.hint.processEmpty: A stopped container has no processes; start it and look again.
en.hint.processTruncated: Output truncated: showing the first {count} processes
en.hint.pullNeedsMutations: docker pull writes to the target's image store and uses disk and bandwidth. Enable “Allow changes” under Settings → Docker containers and you can pull here.
en.hint.pullPlaceholder: Enter an image reference and hit “Pull”; the per-layer progress appears here live.
en.hint.pullProgressDropped: Progress exceeded {lines} rows; the earliest progress lines were dropped
en.hint.readOnlyMode: Starting / stopping / restarting / removing containers, and removing or pruning images, networks and volumes, all require enabling “Allow changes” under Settings → Docker containers.
en.hint.reconnectEvents: Reopen the container event stream (docker events); the list refresh button reconnects it too
en.hint.revealSession: · terminal collapsed, you are in the session
en.hint.runCommandLazy: Generated on demand (read-only, nothing is changed)
en.hint.runCommandOmitted: These were left out of the command: add them yourself after checking.
en.hint.runCommandSecrets: Only the key names are shown, never the values; check before pasting anywhere public.
en.hint.sessionHostNotTarget: Follow the hint above and add a target under Settings → Docker containers (picking a bookmark is recommended), then come back and refresh. To avoid mixing up hosts, the panel never switches to another target on its own.
en.hint.socketRoot: The docker socket is equivalent to root on the target host. Once enabled, both the browser panel and the agent can run these operations — only turn it on in a trusted environment.
en.hint.sparkFollow: Turn on FOLLOW for the live trend
en.hint.staleBook: The referenced bookmark “{book}” no longer exists — pick an existing one, or clear it and fill in the connection manually
en.hint.staleInline: The referenced bookmark “{book}” is not in the tty bookmarks — pick another one, or clear it and fill in manually
en.hint.statsFollowOff: Stop live follow (back to docker stats snapshots)
en.hint.statsFollowOn: Follow resource usage live (docker stats, one row per second)
en.hint.streamKeepsRecent: The stream keeps only the most recent rows; for full history turn off FOLLOW and use snapshots, or lower “LINES”.
en.hint.switchToTarget: Switch to this target's container list
en.hint.targetError: The error banner above says why (target unreachable / docker not running / insufficient permissions). Fix it and hit refresh at the top right.
en.hint.termResize: Drag to resize the terminal (double-click to collapse / expand; focus and use ↑/↓ to fine-tune)
en.hint.tofu: Connections are refused when the fingerprint changes (anti-MITM); once you have confirmed it is safe, delete the record to reconnect. Record deletions take effect after you hit “Save”.
en.hint.ttyNotInstalled: The dsh-tty terminal panel is not installed. The command was copied — paste it into a system terminal (install dsh-tty to open a terminal right here)
en.hint.ttyOutdated: The terminal panel is too old (interactive container access needs dsh-tty ≥ 0.14.0). The command was copied — paste it into a system terminal
en.hint.untrustedLogs: Logs are untrusted content from the container: they may contain credentials or text that tries to steer the model. Review before sending.
en.list.allGoodHint: No containers need attention on any target (unhealthy / restart loop / OOM-killed / non-zero exit / dead).
en.list.diagHistoryEmpty: At least two diagnoses are needed to form a trend (50 runs kept per container)
en.list.diagNoTimeline: No events in the collection window
en.list.diskTruncated: Details truncated to the first {count} rows
en.list.noContainersInNetwork: No container is attached to this network
en.list.noEventsHint: No events yet (container start / die / health actions show up here)
en.list.noHostKeys: No records yet — the host fingerprint is recorded automatically after the first successful SSH connection (reused directly if tty already recorded the same host).
en.list.noLayerInfo: This image has no layer information (scratch build or an old docker).
en.list.noMatch: No matching data on the target, or the filter is too narrow.
en.list.processEmpty: No processes inside the container (it may not be running)
en.list.sessionHostNotTarget: The current session host is not a Docker target yet
en.list.targetError: This target's data could not be loaded
en.msg.filledInCurrentSession: Inserted into the current session input box
en.msg.logDraftFilled: Log snippet inserted into the input box, review before sending
en.msg.logSentToCurrentSession: Log snippet sent to the current session
en.msg.logSentToSession: Log snippet sent to the session
en.msg.pickedAddedSkipped: Added {added}; {skipped} more exceed the limit (at most {max} streams)
en.msg.pickedNone: No containers can be added (already selected or outside the current filter)
en.msg.savedDirty: Saved and applied live (the form got new edits while saving; what you were typing was not overwritten)
en.option.noTtyBooks: (no tty bookmarks, fill in the connection inline)
en.option.orderArrivalHint: Show in arrival order (live follow, zero delay)
en.panel.title: Docker containers
en.placeholder.imageRef: Image reference, e.g. nginx:1.27 or ghcr.io/org/app:latest
en.status.aggConnected: Following {count} container logs (docker logs -f, one shared connection)
en.status.aggEmpty: This project has no containers to aggregate
en.status.backToListRefresh: , the list returns to AUTO REFRESH / manual refresh; hit “Reconnect” on the activity bar to resubscribe
en.status.streamEndedSnapshot: , log stream ended, back to the snapshot
en.status.streamStoppedReconnecting: The server stopped the log stream, reconnecting…
en.status.termDocked: Hosted by the terminal panel · collapsing keeps the session

zh.card.desc: 本机与 SSH 主机的容器与镜像：容器 / 镜像 / 网络 / 卷查看，默认只读，变更操作需显式开启。
zh.card.guide: 本机与 SSH 主机的容器、镜像、Compose、网络与卷
zh.card.name: Docker 容器面板
zh.card.summary: 本机 / SSH 主机上的容器与镜像；默认只读，变更操作需显式开启
zh.check.allowExec: 允许一次性 exec（面板命令框与 docker_exec；交互式进容器不由它管）
zh.check.allowMutations: 允许变更操作（容器启停删、镜像拉取 / 删除 / 清理）
zh.confirm.containerAction: 确定对容器 {name} 执行{action}操作？
zh.confirm.endTerminalHint: 若只是想给日志 / 列表腾地方，先点抽屉右上角的折叠按钮即可，会话会保持运行。
zh.confirm.endTerminalText: 关闭面板会结束「{label}」的终端会话（docker exec -it …）。
zh.confirm.pruneImages: 清理该目标上所有无标签（<none>:<none>）的镜像层，释放磁盘空间；不会删除有 tag 的镜像。
zh.confirm.pruneNetworks: 清理该目标上所有没有容器接入的网络。compose 创建的项目网络也在其中（下次 up 会重建），但正在跑的项目会短暂失去网络。
zh.confirm.pruneVolumes: 清理该目标上所有没有被容器使用的卷——卷里的数据会一起删除且不可恢复。docker ≥ 23 只删匿名卷（不带 --all），更老的版本会连命名卷一起删；执行前请确认没有需要保留的数据卷。
zh.confirm.removeContainer: 确定删除容器 {name}？容器的可写层与配置会被删除（命名数据卷保留），此操作不可恢复。
zh.confirm.removeImage: 确定删除镜像 {ref}？镜像被容器或子镜像引用时会失败；删除后需要重新拉取或构建才能恢复，且不可撤销。
zh.confirm.removeNetwork: 确定删除网络 {name}？还有容器接着时 docker 会拒绝；删除后依赖它的容器会失去网络，需要重新创建或接入别的网络。
zh.confirm.removeVolume: 确定删除卷 {name}？卷里的数据会一起删除且不可恢复；还有容器占用时 docker 会拒绝。
zh.elev.copyAllHint: 每个能力各要一条命令。一次粘贴全部命令，执行后全部开关自动解锁（各自的探测周期内先后生效）。
zh.elev.copyManual: 当前环境拿不到剪贴板，请手动选中上面那条命令复制。
zh.elev.envHow: 在「启动 dsh 的那个环境」里 export {env}=1，然后重启宿主。注意：启动之后再设、或写进别的配置文件都不算授权——这道闸门防的就是「运行期能改的东西冒充授权」。
zh.elev.expired: 本次确认已过期，请重新生成。
zh.elev.lockedWhy: 本机任意进程都能发回环请求，所以「打开危险能力」这件事不能由这个页面自己说了算——必须在宿主的文件系统上确认一次。
zh.elev.otherWay: 另一种方式（最强，需要重启宿主）
zh.elev.revoked: 已撤销宿主授权（配置开关保持不变，重新授权后会立刻生效）。
zh.elev.step: 在宿主的终端里执行下一条命令，开关会自动解锁：
zh.elev.title: 就地授权（免重启）
zh.elev.viaEnv: 由启动环境变量授权；要撤销需在启动环境里去掉它并重启宿主。
zh.elev.waiting: 等待确认…执行完命令这里会自动变成已授权。
zh.error.noConversationService: 宿主缺少 conversation 服务
zh.error.noEventSource: 当前环境不支持 EventSource，无法实时跟随
zh.error.noEventSourcePull: 当前环境不支持 EventSource，无法显示拉取进度
zh.error.noInputFacade: 宿主未提供会话输入门面，无法只填草稿
zh.error.noSessionsService: 宿主未提供 sessions 服务
zh.error.runCommandFailed: 生成等价 docker run 失败
zh.error.sessionNotReady: 会话尚未就绪（作用域未挂载）

zh.hint.addSshTarget: — 到 插件配置 → Docker 容器面板 添加一条 kind=ssh 目标
zh.hint.addTarget: SSH 目标推荐直接选 tty 终端面板的连接簿条目（凭证只需维护一处）；手填时密码 / 口令建议写 env:NAME（凭据引用：由官方凭据存储解析，缺失时退回环境变量）。
zh.hint.addTargetEmpty: 到 插件配置 → Docker 容器面板 添加一个目标：本机直接选「本机」；远程主机可以引用 tty 终端面板的连接簿条目。
zh.hint.aggBufferExceeded: 聚合日志超出缓冲上限（{lines} 行 / {mb}MB），已丢弃最早内容
zh.hint.aggRun: 把所选容器的日志聚合成一条流
zh.hint.aggTail: 每容器拉取的初始行数（{containers} 个容器 → 约 {rows} 行）；改动会重连全部流
zh.hint.attentionDegraded: {count} 个目标的结果已降级（部分容器的详情没取到，OOM / 反复重启可能漏报）
zh.hint.attentionTruncated: 需关注结果已截断：{targets} 个目标实际共 {total} 条，此处只列出前 {shown} 条
zh.hint.autoOn: 按下方间隔重新拉取日志快照
zh.hint.autoRefreshTitle: 自动刷新间隔（开启 AUTO REFRESH 后按此轮询）
zh.hint.bufferExceeded: 日志超出缓冲上限（{lines} 行 / {mb}MB），已丢弃最早内容
zh.hint.byteCap: 这是「字节」上限，不是行数上限——所以 LINES 选了 5000 也可能只回来一部分。想多留日志请到设置卡片调大「输出上限（KB）」，或打开 FOLLOW（流式不受它约束）。
zh.hint.capabilityNotGranted: ⚠ 宿主尚未授权：这两个开关现在打不开，点它会给出一条就地确认的命令（免重启）。关掉它们随时可用。
zh.hint.connectLocal: 加一个指向宿主所在机器的本机目标并选中（已有本机目标则直接复用）；SSH 与自定义目标原样保留。
zh.hint.conversationHidden: · 会话在面板后面：关掉或最小化面板/终端即可看到
zh.hint.diagHistoryDeduped: 本次与上次一致，30 秒内不重复记录
zh.hint.diagHistoryStored: 历史只记结论与数字，不存日志原文
zh.hint.diagReadOnly: 只读：一次采集状态 / 日志 / 事件 / 资源占用
zh.hint.diskDegraded: 这个 docker 版本不支持磁盘明细，只显示汇总
zh.hint.dockerBin: 默认 docker；podman 可填 podman
zh.hint.eventsToggle: 容器事件活动（docker events）：点击折叠 / 展开
zh.hint.execDisabled: 到 插件配置 → Docker 容器面板 打开「允许 exec」，或直接复制卡片上的 exec 命令到终端面板交互式进入容器。
zh.hint.exportMd: 带来源与行数表头，适合当工单附件
zh.hint.exportMenu: 导出当前显示内容：.log（纯文本）/ .md（带来源与行数表头，适合当工单附件）
zh.hint.fetchFailed: （网络请求没到宿主：宿主可能刚重启、或连接被中断）
zh.hint.fillDraft: 不发送；终端折起，你在会话里改完再发
zh.hint.followOff: 关闭实时跟随（回到日志快照）
zh.hint.followOn: 实时跟随容器日志（docker logs -f）
zh.hint.hostNetwork: （host 网络：端口即宿主机端口）
zh.hint.inlineCreds: 内联目标用了 key/password 认证，浏览器端拿不到凭证
zh.hint.keyPath: 支持 ~ 与 ~/ 展开（不支持 ~user）；Windows 请写绝对路径
zh.hint.levelFilter: 按日志级别过滤（显示 ≥ 所选级别；无级别前缀的行是上一条的续行，跟随其级别）
zh.hint.localTarget: 宿主所在机器上的 docker
zh.hint.logBacklog: 主机侧日志积压超出上限（推送速度超过浏览器消费速度），已断开并重连；重连只补新行，不重复历史
zh.hint.logSkipped: 主机侧积压，已跳过 {frames} 批较早的日志（内容不连续）；跟随继续，不用重连
zh.hint.logSkippedNoCount: 主机侧积压，已跳过一批较早的日志（内容不连续）；跟随继续，不用重连
zh.hint.logTailDefault: 面板日志页 LINES 的初始值（面板内可临时改）；它只是「行数」上限——快照还要过下面那道字节闸，所以不保证一定拿得到这么多行
zh.hint.logTailTitle: 拉取的尾部行数。快照另受设置卡片「输出上限（KB）」限制（当前 {kb}KB）——行数够但字节超了仍会截断，实际行数可能更少；FOLLOW 流不受该字节上限约束（由本面板的缓冲上限收口）。
zh.hint.maxOutput: 单次输出的「字节」上限：日志快照 / inspect / exec 共用；日志行数够但字节超了会被截断（面板会给出截断横幅）。FOLLOW 流式日志不受它约束
zh.hint.memSpark: 内存占用% 最近 60 个采样
zh.hint.noHistory: 该 docker 版本既没有 history --format（需要 Docker ≥ 26），纯文本表格也没解析出内容。
zh.hint.openPanelCurrentHost: 打开当前会话主机的 Docker 容器面板
zh.hint.openPanelForTarget: 打开该主机的 Docker 容器面板（目标：{target}）
zh.hint.openPanelUnconfigured: 该主机尚未配置为 Docker 目标 — 点击打开面板查看/配置
zh.hint.openTerminal: 在容器内打开交互式终端（docker exec -it {name} sh）
zh.hint.orderTimeHint: 按容器时间戳合并（跨容器成一条真时间线，代价约 {ms}ms 延迟）
zh.hint.outputTruncated: 日志输出超过「输出上限（{kb}KB）」，已截断
zh.hint.overviewNoTargets: 到 插件配置 → Docker 容器面板 添加目标后，总览会在这里一屏汇总全部主机。
zh.hint.pause: 暂停（冻结当前画面：新日志继续接收但不追加，避免读屏被顶走）
zh.hint.pickBudget: 聚合日志只占一条 SSE（所有选中容器共用一条连接），活动条的事件流另外只占一条
zh.hint.pickMany: 已接近上限，再多就看不清了
zh.hint.pickMaxLocal: 最多 {max} 个容器——再多一次读不清，宿主上也会多起几条 logs 进程
zh.hint.pickMaxSsh: 最多 {max} 个容器——再多一次读不清，SSH 通道也会被占满
zh.hint.pickPreset: 在当前筛选结果里勾选「{label}」的容器（最多 {max} 个流）
zh.hint.pickPresetOver: ；另有 {count} 个超出上限不会选中
zh.hint.processEmpty: 容器已停止时取不到进程；启动后再看。
zh.hint.processTruncated: 输出已截断，只显示前 {count} 个进程
zh.hint.pullNeedsMutations: docker pull 会写入目标机的镜像存储并占用磁盘与带宽。到 插件配置 → Docker 容器面板 打开「允许变更操作」后即可在此拉取。
zh.hint.pullPlaceholder: 填写镜像引用后点「拉取」，逐层进度会实时出现在这里。
zh.hint.pullProgressDropped: 进度超过 {lines} 行，最早的进度行已被丢弃
zh.hint.readOnlyMode: 容器的启动 / 停止 / 重启 / 删除，以及镜像、网络、卷的删除与清理，都需要到 插件配置 → Docker 容器面板 打开「允许变更操作」。
zh.hint.reconnectEvents: 重新打开容器事件流（docker events）；列表刷新按钮也会一并重连
zh.hint.revealSession: · 已折起终端，你在会话里
zh.hint.runCommandLazy: 点开才生成（只读，不改动容器）
zh.hint.runCommandOmitted: 这些没有写进命令：需要时请自己确认后补上。
zh.hint.runCommandSecrets: 这里只点名键名、不显示值；贴到公开位置前先确认。
zh.hint.sessionHostNotTarget: 按上面的提示到 插件配置 → Docker 容器面板 添加一条目标（推荐直接选连接簿条目），保存后回到这里刷新。为避免张冠李戴，面板不会自动切到其他目标。
zh.hint.socketRoot: docker socket 等价于目标主机的 root 权限。开启后，浏览器面板与 agent 都能执行对应操作，请只在可信环境下打开。
zh.hint.sparkFollow: 打开 FOLLOW 看实时趋势
zh.hint.staleBook: 引用的连接簿条目「{book}」不存在——请改选一个已有条目，或清空改为手填
zh.hint.staleInline: 引用的条目「{book}」不在 tty 连接簿里——请改选，或清空后手填
zh.hint.statsFollowOff: 关闭实时跟随（回到 docker stats 快照）
zh.hint.statsFollowOn: 实时跟随资源占用（docker stats 每秒一行）
zh.hint.streamKeepsRecent: 流式日志只保留最近的行；需要完整历史请关掉 FOLLOW 用快照，或调小「LINES」。
zh.hint.switchToTarget: 切到该目标的容器列表
zh.hint.targetError: 上面的错误条里有原因（目标不可达 / docker 未运行 / 权限不足）。修好后点右上角刷新即可。
zh.hint.termResize: 拖动调整终端高度（双击折叠 / 展开；聚焦后 ↑/↓ 微调）
zh.hint.tofu: 指纹变更时连接会被拒绝（防中间人）；确认安全后删除对应记录即可重连。删除记录在点「保存」后生效。
zh.hint.ttyNotInstalled: 未安装 dsh-tty 终端面板，命令已复制，可粘贴到系统终端执行（装 dsh-tty 后可直接在此开终端）
zh.hint.ttyOutdated: 终端面板版本过旧（交互式进入容器需要 dsh-tty ≥ 0.14.0），命令已复制，可粘贴到系统终端执行
zh.hint.unreachableTail: （其余目标的正常结果不受影响）
zh.hint.untrustedLogs: 日志是容器里的不可信内容：可能含凭证，也可能含试图操纵模型的指令文本，发送前请过目。
zh.list.allGoodHint: 所有目标上都没有需要关注的容器（不健康 / 反复重启 / 被 OOM 杀 / 非零退出 / 僵死）。
zh.list.diagHistoryEmpty: 至少两次诊断才能形成趋势（每个容器保留最近 50 次）
zh.list.diskTruncated: 明细已截断，只显示前 {count} 行
zh.list.noContainersInNetwork: 没有容器接入这个网络
zh.list.noEventsHint: 暂无事件（容器的 start / die / health 等动作会出现在这里）
zh.list.noHostKeys: 暂无记录 — 首次 SSH 连接成功后自动记录主机指纹（若 tty 已记录同一主机，会直接复用）。
zh.list.noLayerInfo: 该镜像没有层信息（scratch 构建或旧版 docker）。
zh.list.noMatch: 目标上没有匹配的数据，或筛选条件过窄。
zh.list.noTargetsConfigured: 还没有配置 Docker 目标
zh.list.processEmpty: 容器内没有进程（容器可能未在运行）
zh.list.sessionHostNotTarget: 当前会话主机还不是 Docker 目标
zh.list.targetError: 这个目标的数据没读到
zh.list.waitingPull: 等待 docker pull 输出…
zh.msg.filledInCurrentSession: 已填入当前会话的输入框
zh.msg.logDraftFilled: 日志片段已填入输入框，确认后再发送
zh.msg.logSentToCurrentSession: 已发送日志片段到当前会话
zh.msg.logSentToSession: 日志片段已发送到会话
zh.msg.pickedAddedSkipped: 已新增 {added} 个，另有 {skipped} 个超出上限（最多 {max} 个流）未选
zh.msg.pickedNone: 没有可新增的容器（已被勾选或不在当前筛选结果里）
zh.msg.savedDirty: 已保存并热生效（表单在保存期间有新编辑，未覆盖你正在输入的内容）
zh.option.noTtyBooks: （无 tty 连接簿，请填内联信息）
zh.option.orderArrivalHint: 按到达顺序显示（实时跟随零延迟）
zh.panel.runCommand: 等价 docker run（只读推导）
zh.panel.title: Docker 容器
zh.placeholder.filterServiceLogs: 过滤服务名 / 日志内容…
zh.placeholder.imageRef: 镜像引用，如 nginx:1.27 或 ghcr.io/org/app:latest
zh.placeholder.searchCompose: 搜索项目 / 服务 / 容器
zh.placeholder.searchContainers: 搜索名称 / 镜像 / ID
zh.placeholder.searchImages: 搜索镜像（仓库 / 标签 / ID）
zh.placeholder.searchNetworks: 搜索网络（名称 / 驱动 / ID）
zh.placeholder.searchVolumes: 搜索卷（名称 / 驱动 / 挂载点）
zh.status.aggClosed: 全部容器日志流已结束
zh.status.aggConnected: 正在跟随 {count} 个容器的日志（docker logs -f，共用一条连接）
zh.status.aggEmpty: 该项目没有可聚合的容器
zh.status.aggReconnecting: 部分连接中断，正在自动重连…
zh.status.backToListRefresh: ，列表回到 AUTO REFRESH / 手动刷新；活动条上点「重连」可重新订阅
zh.status.needMutations: 需要打开「允许变更操作」
zh.status.reconnecting: 连接中断，正在自动重连…
zh.status.streamStoppedReconnecting: 服务端已停止日志流，正在重连…
zh.status.termCollapsed: 已折叠 · 会话保持运行
zh.status.termDocked: 由终端面板承载 · 折叠保留会话
